InstOp.String.claim: Returns the name of each of the eleven instruction opcodes and the empty string for any other opcode.

ranges.Len.claim: Returns the number of complete endpoint pairs.
ranges.Len.limits: Valid Unicode numeric endpoints (including surrogate code points), even pair-aligned destination lengths/capacities and valid pair indexes for Less and Swap. Clean sources are sorted, separated, and disjoint from destination. Native compares visible results, original backing and reuse of nonempty backing for writes. Allocation sizes and nil versus nonnil zero-capacity identity are abstracted. No regexp compilation or matching.
ranges.Len.configurations: Pinned private Go via same-package test overlay, compiled Lean and separate endpoint arithmetic/state oracle. 5,040 fixed rows and 60,000 samples at seeds 17, 2718 and 65537. Less and Swap execute on 55,695 nonempty rows with valid indices.
